name: Bashful
summary: A shy Get in touch button that leans away, blushes, sweats and hops when you poke it
about: A chunky yellow contact button with a face. It leans away from your cursor on springs, blinks, blushes and breaks into a nervous sweat when you get too close. Pressing it squeezes its eyes shut, then it hops, smiles and unfolds a contact card with a copyable email and a call request that end in hearts and confetti. Great for portfolios, agency sites and landing pages.
how: Move the cursor near: the button tilts away, its eyes follow you, its cheeks blush and a sweat drop appears up close.
Press and hold: it squashes and squeezes its eyes shut. Let go: it hops with a wobble.
A contact card unfolds under it with its contents arriving one by one, and the button smiles.
Copy puts the email on your clipboard with a heart burst; Book a call shows hopping dots, then a tick and confetti.
Press Escape, the close button or the main button to fold the card away.
